name: worklog

descriptions.claude: Turn work sessions into reviewed session logs and project logs.
descriptions.codex: Track work sessions with reviewed session logs and project logs.
descriptions.short: Reviewed session logs and project context for agent work.
descriptions.long: Worklog turns agent work sessions into human-reviewed session logs and project logs, then uses the approved record to resume future work. Shared projects keep drafts local and publish only approved artifacts.

default_prompts: Start Worklog setup for this project.
